column1: # The taxa that count as MICROBIAL (Ludmil review #14; Ammal, 16 Nov 2026): the MetaPhlAn gate
# (--consensus_min_reads) and the QC summary's bracken_microbial_reads sum the KrakenUniq clade
# counts of exactly these taxids. The scope matches the validation reference's RefSeq groups
# (bacteria, archaea, fungi, protozoa). "Protozoa" is not one NCBI clade, so it is this fixed list
# of top-level protist lineages, covering every organism in RefSeq's protozoa section (Plasmodium,
# Toxoplasma, Babesia, Cryptosporidium, Leishmania, Trypanosoma, Entamoeba, Acanthamoeba, Giardia,
# Trichomonas, Naegleria, Balantidium, Blastocystis, ...). Every taxid is verified present in
# krakenUniq_8_8_2023/taxDB with the name and rank below, and NO entry is nested inside another
# (Fungi excluded from the protist clades; Bacteria/Archaea/eukaryote lineages disjoint), so no
# read is ever counted twice. Viruses are deliberately NOT in scope (the consensus already excludes
# them); human (9606) and synthetic construct (32630) were never in scope.
